admin.description: The tools to manage this instance will appear here.
admin.title: Administration

starting.description: The server is getting ready, for example after an update. Verve opens as soon as it is ready.
starting.title: Verve is starting

unreachable.description: Verve cannot reach the server. It will try again automatically.
unreachable.title: Server unreachable

copy.failed: Copying failed. Select the text and copy it.

errors.csrf_failed: The request was blocked as a security measure. Reload the page and try again.
errors.email_invalid: Enter an email address with an @.
errors.email_taken: Another account already has this email address.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid_credentials: The username, email or password is incorrect.
errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation link is no longer valid: it was already used, it expired, or it is incomplete. Ask an admin for a new link.
errors.password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
errors.password_too_long: Use at most 128 characters for the password.
errors.password_too_short: Use at least 12 characters for the password.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.rate_limited_wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{wait}}.
errors.reset_link_invalid: This password reset link is no longer valid: it was already used, it expired, a newer one replaced it, or it is incomplete. Ask an admin for a new link.
errors.setup_completed: Verve is already set up. Log in with an existing account.
errors.setup_token_invalid: This setup token is not valid. Each start of Verve writes a new setup link to its log: use the latest one.
errors.timezone_invalid: Verve does not know this timezone. Enter a name such as Europe/Paris.
errors.username_invalid: Use 1 to 64 characters for the username, without @, spaces or invisible characters.
errors.username_taken: Another account already has this username.

home.tagline: Your health data, on your server.

invite.askNewInvitation: Ask an admin for a new invitation.
invite.description: You are invited to Verve as {{username}}. Choose your password to create your account.
invite.title: Join Verve

login.passwordChanged: Your password changed. Log in with it.
login.title: Log in

notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
notFound.title: Page not found

resetPassword.description: Choose the new password of your account. Every session of the account ends, and you log in again with the new password.
resetPassword.title: Reset your password

account.description: This account administers Verve. Like every account, it keeps its own health data.
account.title: Admin account

import.description: Verve shows the Apple Health data that you send to it, in two ways:
import.export: Your history: on your iPhone, open the Health app, tap your profile picture, then Export All Health Data, and upload the export.zip file to Verve.
import.sync: Continuous sync: the Health Auto Export app sends your new data to Verve on a schedule.
import.title: Import your data

token.description: When it starts, Verve writes a setup link to its log, on the line that begins with "Create the first admin". Paste the link, or the token after its # sign.
token.label: Setup link or token
token.required: Enter the setup link or the token.
token.title: Setup token

timezone.description: Your days start at midnight in this timezone. It comes from your browser: correct it if it is wrong.
timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.title: Confirm your timezone

create.description: Choose what the token can do. Verve shows it only once, right after it is created.
create.name: Name
create.nameTooLong: Use at most {{max}} characters for the name.
create.title: Create a token

created.description: Copy the token now: Verve shows it only once.
created.title: Token created

tokens.description: Tokens let apps such as Health Auto Export send or read your data without your password.

empty.description: Create a token to connect an app to Verve: Health Auto Export to sync the health data of your iPhone, or a script that reads your data. A token only does what its scopes allow, and you can revoke it at any time.
empty.title: No token yet

healthAutoExport.description: In a REST API automation of Health Auto Export, enter this URL and add this header.
healthAutoExport.title: Configure Health Auto Export

healthAutoExport.description: Sends the health data of your iPhone to Verve. Scope: ingest.
healthAutoExport.label: Health Auto Export

readOnly.description: Reads your data, for a dashboard or a script. Scope: read.
readOnly.label: Read only

revoke.description: The apps that use this token stop working at their next request. You cannot undo this.
revoke.label: Revoke {{name}}
revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.unused: Not used for 90 days or more. Revoke it if no app needs it anymore.
